data.name: Zippy
data.shortDescription: Shows zipline information on a display attached to the rope gun.
data.description:
# ZIPPY


Once the mod is installed you will find a new display attached to the rope gun.
The display will show the distance from the first placed point to the currently aimed at point.
The preferred measurement (distance or percent) and placement of the display can be changed from within the mod settings.
Beyond the display the rope gun will also change the sound pitch depending on the distance.
